note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient dialogue).
- The DDx JSON (as provided by the diagnostic agent).

Format notes:
- Use American English, concise professional tone.
- Extract only clinically relevant information (presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, allergies, medications, social history, physical findings, plan).
- Do not invent data (vitals, labs, doses) beyond what appears in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, record the name and note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Structure exactly as requested:
 1) Subjective
 2) Objective
 3) Assessment & Plan
   - Issue 1 (name only): assessment, DDx (only if consistent), investigations, treatment, referrals
   - Issue 2 (name only): ... (as above)
   - Issue 3, 4, 5, etc. (if present)
 4) Quality checks (at bottom): list missing elements, conflicts, and transcript quality notes

If you paste or attach the actual content here, I will generate the complete SOAP note in the specified format.
